entities.name: Tegwyll
entities.description: A 400-year-old faerie noble of Eldraine, ambitious for the throne of the Kind Lord.

entities.name: Alela
entities.description: A lesser faerie schemer, Tegwyll's ally, who leads a gang of faeries.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: The Kind Lord, ruler of the High Fae court in Tuinvale.

entities.name: High Fae
entities.description: The noble fae who look down on faeries.

events.summary: Pushed aside in Talion's court, Tegwyll allies with the lesser faerie Alela.
events.quote: Tegwyll knew exactly who to contact: Alela

events.summary: Tegwyll returns to court in a lavish coming-of-age ceremony escorted by flights of faeries.
events.quote: Tegwyll made his return in a lavish coming-of-age ceremony escorted by flights of faeries

events.summary: Alela and her gang secretly sully the reputations of those Tegwyll cannot convince.
events.quote: Those he could not convince of his worth were set upon in secret by Alela and her gang

events.summary: Tegwyll sets his sights on the throne of the Kind Lord.
events.quote: Tegywll has set his sights upon the final prize - the throne of the Kind Lord.

relations.note: uses her faeries as eyes and ears
relations.quote: there were no better eyes and ears for Tegwyll than the flitting, mischievous faeries that served Alela in droves
